images.name: sankey-efficiency
images.prompt: Create a clean flat 2D textbook Sankey diagram on a white background, landscape 3:2, no photographic objects, no motor, no socket, no pulley, no decorative effects. Scientific accuracy is essential. Exactly one horizontal blue input band splits into two bands: a teal horizontal band continues to the right and a thin amber band bends down. Use these exact band thicknesses in the drawing: blue input 100 pixels tall, teal output 70 pixels tall, amber waste output 30 pixels wide along its vertical section. 70 + 30 = 100. The blue input runs into one junction, teal output aligns with the upper 70 pixels of the input, the lower 30 pixels of the input turn smoothly downward into an amber band with constant 30-pixel width. Arrowheads at each outlet may broaden only at their tips; the rectangular band shafts remain 70 and 30 pixels. Give the whole diagram very generous empty margins and put three exact large dark navy labels entirely outside the bands: '500 J input' above the blue input, '350 J useful' above the teal output, '150 J heat' beside the downward amber outlet. Keep text clear, no overlapping shapes. No other text, symbols, chart bars, extra arrows, shadows or textures.
